content.rationale: Undo takes the marker at pos-1 by the inverse its kind records — reverting its kept entries newest first, one revert per kept entry for every kind, so a creation, a recording and a removal all undo as a whole operation — and records the reverts it made; a position at zero refuses, and a revert that refuses partway refuses the whole undo, leaving the state as it began and naming the refusing entry (the refusal semantics of `qxmzpupt`). The position moves one back (kpptprql), so the next undo takes the previous operation.
